what.text: This page follows refugees from Mexico living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 26994 Mexican refugees in Canada, 65.3% of all refugees from Mexico.
Canada is the largest host of Mexican refugees, followed by the United States, Spain and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mexico with the EZLN in 1994 and the EPR in 1996.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Mexico in recent years, so it does not say why the number of refugees grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 239 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
